candidates.name: stagnation_avoidance_search
candidates.hypothesis: Guiding the agent in context_mgmt to detect search query stagnation—specifically prompting it to avoid repeating failed query formulations, to pivot orthogonal clues when a search direction produces irrelevant or repetitive documents, and to search for distinctive single entities/phrases rather than overcrowded conjunctions—will reduce wasted turns on dead ends and increase pass rate from 46.7% to >=53.3%.
candidates.changes: Augment context_mgmt extra_system with explicit anti-stagnation heuristics: pivot orthogonal clues when top results repeat or are irrelevant, avoid query repetition, and avoid stuffing more than 2-3 constraints into a single query.
candidates.expected_efficiency: Reduces mean turns from ~20.8 to <19 by cutting loops on unproductive queries, saving token usage on stalled episodes.
